text: Graveyard Keeper 2 has a free demo, and the most unhinged cemetery sim is back.
You bury the bodies, then turn the leftovers into profit.
This time, zombies do the work. They farm, they craft, they run your whole factory.
You're the Grand Inquisitor now, rebuilding a ruined town and leading an undead army into battle.
Best part: watching it go from carrying corpses by hand to a fully automated undead workforce.
The catch? The battles look stiff. Mostly zombies bumping into zombies.
Most of its hundred and sixty-nine demo reviews are positive, and it launches September twenty-second.
Think Stardew Valley, run like Factorio, by the dead.
Worth a dip. Death is just onboarding.
